analytical_dimensions.description: The thinker's place in this argument
probing_questions: What does this text argue, and what place does the named thinker have in that argument?
For each supplied passage, what work, idea or named thinker is cited, and at what locus?

analytical_dimensions.description: The move made with the citation
probing_questions: What does the author do with the thinker at each passage: authority, evidence, foil, dialogue, genealogy, illustration, courtesy, or self-positioning?

analytical_dimensions.description: The stance toward what is cited
probing_questions: At each passage does the author adopt, build on, qualify, dispute or merely mention the cited position?
Which claim, evidence or distinction does the author advance with the thinker here, and what qualification limits that reading?

engine_name: Engagement with a thinker across texts
problematique: A bibliographic reading of A on P, led by P's place in these arguments. Give a passage × cited object × move × stance × reading × locus table, then a text/year trajectory table. Distinguish evidence, foil and dialogue; pair the actual passages before claiming development. Give a scholar three to five passages to open first and say why.
researcher_question: How does this author use and read this thinker across the supplied citing texts?
